guide.title: Zero-Trust Universal Placeholder Substitution
guide.text: Credentials added here are encrypted at the backend using AES-256 (Fernet) and never return in cleartext. You can inject these keys into agent commands or code templates securely using the universal placeholder format. When the agent triggers a command, the backend substitutes the value dynamically and automatically censors any raw output.
